note: Decided-phantom carry registry (S249). The genius-list generator keeps re-surfacing carries whose premise a later DECISIONS.md entry REVERSED — distinct from a resolved-DONE carry. A phantom here is suppressed ONLY WHILE its `supersededBy` decision id is actually present in context/DECISIONS.md (decision-backed guard: the suppressor can never silently bury a live item — reverse/remove the decision and the carry automatically returns to the hit list). `match` (required) + optional `requires` are case-insensitive regex sources ANDed against the candidate task/title. Append a new entry at closeout whenever you re-reject a carry with evidence, so the same phantom stops burning a top-5 slot every session. Validate with: node scripts/check-phantom-carries.mjs
